name: @trevrpc/trevrpc-js
description: JavaScript WebTransport runtime and protobuf.js code generator for TrevRPC

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:native:test && npm test && npm run build:native && npm run verify:native:production
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.verify:native:production: node -e 'const { readFileSync } = require("node:fs"); const path = "./build/native/trevrpc_native.node"; const expectedExports = ["connectMsQuic", "createCancellation", "listenMsQuic"]; const actualExports = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(require(path)).sort(); const exportsMatch = JSON.stringify(actualExports) === JSON.stringify(expectedExports); const embedsDebugNames = readFileSync(path).includes(Buffer.from("_debug")); if (!exportsMatch || embedsDebugNames) throw new Error(`production addon exports ${JSON.stringify(actualExports)}; expected exactly ${JSON.stringify(expectedExports)}${embedsDebugNames ? "; binary contains _debug" : ""}`);'
